angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 27,132,300 km at 1174.30 pc = 0.31 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, ST Tau: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1174.3 +/- 115 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1174.3 +/- 115 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.8812 +/- 0.0340 mas (same row, RUWE 1.35), 25.9 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 39 +/- 3.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, ST Tau: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39 +/- 3.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 27,132,300 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 153, Name='ST Tau', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 153, Name='ST Tau', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
